WITH latest AS ( SELECT available_inventory::double precision AS current_value FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 1 ), past AS ( SELECT available_inventory::double precision AS past_value FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' AND collected_at <= COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(collected_at) FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' AND collected_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours') /* , (SELECT MIN(collected_at) FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}') */ ) ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT NOW() AS time, (latest.current_value - past.past_value) / NULLIF(past.past_value, 0) AS value FROM latest CROSS JOIN past

WITH latest AS ( SELECT available_inventory::double precision AS current_value FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 1 ), past AS ( SELECT available_inventory::double precision AS past_value FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' AND collected_at <= COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(collected_at) FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' AND collected_at <= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') /* , (SELECT MIN(collected_at) FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}') */ ) ORDER BY collected_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) SELECT NOW() AS time, (latest.current_value - past.past_value) / NULLIF(past.past_value, 0) AS value FROM latest CROSS JOIN past

targets.rawSql: WITH base_inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' ), quote_inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${quote_asset:raw}' ), combined AS ( SELECT b.collected_at, b.inv AS b_inv, q.inv AS q_inv, AVG(b.inv) OVER w AS b_mean, NULLIF(STDDEV(b.inv) OVER w, 0) AS b_std, AVG(q.inv) OVER w AS q_mean, NULLIF(STDDEV(q.inv) OVER w, 0) AS q_std FROM base_inv b JOIN quote_inv q ON b.collected_at = q.collected_at WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY b.collected_at ROWS BETWEEN 287 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ) SELECT collected_at AS time, COALESCE(-(q_inv - q_mean) / q_std, 0) - COALESCE(-(b_inv - b_mean) / b_std, 0) AS directional_stress FROM combined WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at

SELECT collected_at AS time, available_inventory::double precision AS inventory FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(collected_at) ORDER BY collected_at

WITH inv AS ( SELECT collected_at, available_inventory::double precision AS inv, LAG(available_inventory::double precision) OVER (ORDER BY collected_at) AS prev_inv FROM margin_available_inventory_snapshots WHERE asset = '${asset:raw}' ), changes AS ( SELECT collected_at, -GREATEST(0, prev_inv - inv) AS borrow_proxy, GREATEST(0, inv - prev_inv) AS repay_proxy FROM inv WHERE prev_inv IS NOT NULL ), bucketed AS ( SELECT time_bucket('${inv_interval}', collected_at) AS time, SUM(borrow_proxy) AS borrow_proxy, SUM(repay_proxy) AS repay_proxy FROM changes WHERE $__timeFilter(collected_at) GROUP BY 1 ), bounds AS ( SELECT GREATEST(COALESCE(MAX(ABS(borrow_proxy)),0), COALESCE(MAX(repay_proxy),0)) * 1.3 AS mx FROM bucketed ), padding AS ( SELECT $__timeFrom()::timestamp AS time, -mx AS borrow_proxy, mx AS repay_proxy FROM bounds ) SELECT time, borrow_proxy, repay_proxy FROM bucketed UNION ALL SELECT time, borrow_proxy, repay_proxy FROM padding ORDER BY time

WITH ratios AS ( SELECT close_time, CASE WHEN (volume - taker_buy_base_volume) > 0 THEN (taker_buy_base_volume / (volume - taker_buy_base_volume))::double precision ELSE NULL END AS ratio, LAG( CASE WHEN (volume - taker_buy_base_volume) > 0 THEN (taker_buy_base_volume / (volume - taker_buy_base_volume))::double precision ELSE NULL END ) OVER (ORDER BY close_time) AS prev_ratio FROM spot_klines WHERE symbol = '${symbol:raw}' ) SELECT close_time AS time, CASE WHEN prev_ratio > 0 AND ratio > 0 THEN LN(ratio / prev_ratio) * 100 ELSE NULL END AS buy_sell_log_change FROM ratios WHERE $__timeFilter(close_time) ORDER BY close_time
